thesis: Nasdaq Inc. operates global market infrastructure: the Nasdaq Stock Market and other exchanges, clearing and transaction services, index licensing, market data, and financial-technology software for anti-financial crime, regulatory reporting, and capital-markets workflows. **[Fact]** Customers pay listing, transaction, subscription, and SaaS fees; Nasdaq does not take directional market risk on customer positions. **[Fact]** FY2025 net revenues less transaction-based expenses were **$5,249 million**, operating income **$2,331 million**, and net income **$1,788 million** (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-K_20260212_rpt20251231_acc0001628280_26_007703.htm`). **[Fact]** Q1 2026 net revenues less transaction-based expenses were **$1,407 million** (+14% versus **$1,237 million** in Q1 2025); operating income **$657 million** (+20%); net income **$519 million** (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-Q_20260424_rpt20260331_acc0001628280_26_027105.htm`). Adena Friedman is Chair and CEO.
why_market_wrong: There is no dated payoff or structural discount here. **[Inference]** Q1 2026 operating income reflects record U.S. cash-equity and equity-derivative volumes plus a **$89 million** net gain on divestitures; the market may treat that pace as permanent. **[Inference]** Our base return uses FY2025 owner cash per share (**$3.44**), not the Q1 2026 earnings run rate. Return is franchise earnings power at price, not a mispricing signal with a known catalyst date.
